listing.name: Show Fleet DP
listing.summary: For all the times you underestimated that modded bounty. Shows enemy's fleet DP and effective strength (how strong it is in autoresolve)
listing.aiSummary: Displays enemy fleet deployment points and effective strength during interactions.

description: Shows the total deployment points of an enemy fleet. It also displays the fleet's effective strength as calculated for auto-resolve.
